# FilDOS

> FilDOS is an open-source (MIT), AI-native file browser for your PC, released for macOS and Linux. It searches documents, photos, audio and video by meaning, entirely on-device — no accounts, no cloud processing, no telemetry.

## What it does

- **Search by meaning**: one on-device embedding model (EmbeddingGemma 2) places text, pictures, video frames and sound in one space, so "receipts from tax season" or "the part of the lecture about kestrels" finds the right file. Filename and exact-word matches (codes, IDs) are fused into the same ranked list.
- **Hits know their place**: a PDF result opens at the matching page with the words highlighted; an audio or video result plays from the matching moment. A query with no real answer returns nothing.
- **Search with a preview**: results show beside a live preview of the selected file.
- **Quick Look**: press Space on any file to preview pictures, PDF pages, recordings, text, code and documents in place.
- **Ask AI**: chat with your files through a local LLM (llama.cpp; Llama, Qwen, Gemma, Phi, Mistral, DeepSeek, or any GGUF). Mention files and folders, run `/find`, and let it create, copy, move or rename files — deletes go to the OS Trash.
- **Canvas**: a knowledge graph of how your files connect, by meaning, people and places, tags and time.
- **A real file manager**: list, grid, gallery and column views, tags, recents, undo, drag and drop, Google Drive and Dropbox side by side with local folders.
- **Private by default**: secrets (.env, keys, certificates, credentials) are never indexed, and any file, folder or file type can be hidden from AI.

## Technology

- Electron, React, TypeScript
- On-device embeddings: EmbeddingGemma 2 on ONNX Runtime
- On-device chat: node-llama-cpp
- Storage: SQLite (built into Node), Drizzle ORM
